assessments.boundary: Existing default resident stdio retained and regression-tested; no replacement manager.
Legacy initialization retained; only explicit 2026-07-28 HTTP selects modern mode. Modern stdio and full compatibility fallback remain absent.
Explicit modern HTTP discovery and per-request metadata; not a general conformance certification.
Bounded schema-derived method/name/primitive parameter headers, pinned per call; unsupported annotations reject.
Legacy/modern JSON and SSE framing plus controlled DNS/TLS regressions; external network/platform qualification unrun.
Legacy session lifecycle/recovery retained under owner fences; modern mode does not establish sessions.
Shared deadlines/cancellation and bounded controls; no ambiguous action replay or rollback promise.
Modern subscriptions/listen and resource subscriptions are not implemented.
Transactional bounded catalogs, retained schemas and call/dispatch epoch fencing.
Explicit refresh and legacy tool-change handling; no cross-owner cache. Modern subscriptions/freshness qualification remain open.
Bounded acyclic local references/composition/constraints; unsupported keywords/dialects/recursion reject. Structured-only output is explicitly rendered.
Bounded existing media and resource-bearing results; URI contents are untrusted data, not host fetch permission.
Synthetic resource list/template/read tools use existing connections and opaque URIs; subscriptions separately absent.
Prompts/get/completions remain unsupported; baseline scope distinction retained.
Bounded flat primitive/enum private forms; credential-like and advanced forms deny. Full-fit TUI only; Serve private channel absent.
Private manual HTTPS URL interaction; no opening/fetching. TUI display bounds and unrun real URL/OAuth journeys remain.
Eligible modern HTTP tool/resource MRTR fixes original arguments, exact operation-local state/IDs and shared budgets; no failure replay.
Sampling is not implemented or advertised.
Roots are not implemented or advertised.
Bounded numeric progress and safe diagnostics; modern subscription logging surface is not implemented.
Unauthenticated/bearer paths and explicit private setup exist; arbitrary static headers are unsupported.
Configured exact issuer plus protected-resource/OAuth/OIDC discovery; transport WWW-Authenticate challenges are not yet carried into login.
Pre-registered public-client PKCE, state/issuer/resource checks and manual loopback/callback completion; no live account or combined frontend qualification.
Reviewed pre-registered public clients only; no Octet-published CIMD identity or dynamic registration.
Durable owner/config/issuer/client/scope keys, plaintext private store, expiry/rotating refresh and local logout; no remote grant revocation or secure erasure.
Generic exact-call Ask/one-use redemption with full preview and dispatch fences. This does not complete #383 typed app/origin/fresh-observation automation policy.
Nine retained HTTP defect boundaries have candidate fixes/regressions; source tests do not qualify privileged networks, sensitive credentials or all platforms.
Stock SDK/runtime/manager composition and TUI/Serve reducers tested. Private input requires full-fit TUI with write logging off; Serve cancels. Combined product/live qualification unrun.
Deprecated standalone HTTP+SSE remains unsupported.
Tasks and additional protocol extensions remain unsupported.
Enterprise-managed authorization remains absent; no full Codex parity claim.
Codex-specific forms/verification/app extensions remain absent; standard interactions are not excluded by that distinction.

limitations: No live Shopify storefront /api/mcp or /api/ucp/mcp, Wix account, customer OAuth, checkout, purchase or enterprise journey was executed. Storefront/TLS/issuer fixtures do not substitute for them.
The combined real Serve/browser lifecycle harness could not start: required Chromium headless executable unavailable. No browser was installed to bypass that blocker.

Private TUI context is escaped and full-fit only, bounded to 16 KiB raw/escaped and 4096 answer bytes. OCTET_TUI_WRITE_LOG must be unset. Serve private input remains unavailable, including non-secret ToolProgress input; command setup is headless.
Parent command completion/timeout and tool-owner settlement are tested. Child-only UI cancellation while its parent remains active is not independently qualified.

Full workspace test/doc-test, audit/deny, release-signing/distribution, cross-platform and credentialed live gates were not executed for this final candidate. Relevant crate suites, workspace check/clippy and controlled web tests are not a waiver.
